breaking_news.headline: More people are going hungry now than at the height of the pandemic
breaking_news.summary: Food insecurity affects more families now than during the coronavirus pandemic, according to a new survey from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

breaking_news.headline: NPR's newsroom shrinks through buyouts and layoffs
breaking_news.summary: At least 18 NPR journalists have accepted buyouts and another 10 have been laid off as the public media network attempts to save money and reorganize the newsroom.

breaking_news.headline: DOJ charges Google staffer over Polymarket trades netting $1.2 million
breaking_news.summary: It's the second known case of the federal government filing criminal charges against someone who allegedly used insider information to make a large profit on a prediction market site.

breaking_news.headline: Ferrari unveiled its first EV model. The response has been lukewarm
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Mack Hogan of Inside EVs about the lukewarm consumer response to Ferrari's first electric vehicle.

breaking_news.headline: Trump wants a gas tax holiday. There's a much bigger problem looming
breaking_news.summary: Suspending the federal gasoline tax could save drivers up to 18.4 cents per gallon. But it would drain the fund meant to cover roadbuilding and repairs — a fund that's already in trouble.

breaking_news.headline: These swing voters are adding high gas prices into their political calculations
breaking_news.summary: As part of NPR's Swing Shift project checking in with swing voters, these Americans are split on who is to blame for high gas prices but they all agree it has an impact on their personal finances.

breaking_news.headline: This is how close American households are to the financial edge
breaking_news.summary: A new report shows that nearly half of U.S. households did not earn enough to cover their necessities in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA's World Cup ticket sales outraged fans. Now they are under investigation
breaking_news.summary: FIFA has always had a peculiar way to sell tickets to the World Cup. It never faced any major issues — until prices soared for the 2026 tournament.

breaking_news.headline: Ex-head monk of China's 'kung fu temple' jailed for embezzlement
breaking_news.summary: Shi Yongxin is sentenced to 24 years in prison for embezzlement and bribery.

breaking_news.headline: US and Iran 'very close' to deal but 'not there yet', Vance says
breaking_news.summary: US officials earlier told the BBC that the framework of a ceasefire extension deal had been agreed, pending the approval of Trump and Iran's leadership.

breaking_news.headline: Exploding rocket casts doubts over Nasa's Moon plans
breaking_news.summary: Explosion of Blue Origin rocket is a setback for the company and for Nasa's Moon plans.

breaking_news.headline: Eight students arrested in Kenya after suspected deadly school arson attack
breaking_news.summary: Sixteen pupils died in the fire that ripped through a dormitory while they were asleep.

breaking_news.headline: Former US attorney general Pam Bondi testifies in congressional Epstein probe
breaking_news.summary: The testimony comes about a month after America's top prosecutor was ousted by US President Donald Trump.

breaking_news.headline: 'Controversial' North Korean invasion setting for next Call of Duty game
breaking_news.summary: Developer Infinity Ward said the game will be "grounded in the military authenticity" the series is known for.

breaking_news.headline: Nato condemns Russian 'recklessness' after drone hits Romanian residential block
breaking_news.summary: Romania will hold an emergency meeting following the incident, in which two people were injured.

breaking_news.headline: 'Poison seller' who sold toxic chemicals online to people across world admits aiding suicides
breaking_news.summary: Kenneth Law admitted charges relating to Canadian victims - but families say he should also be charged in the UK over 79 deaths in Britain.

breaking_news.headline: Blue Origin rocket explodes into huge ball of flame on Florida launch pad
breaking_news.summary: Amazon billionaire Jeff Bezos, who founded Blue Origin, said it was a "very rough day".

breaking_news.headline: When trade soured, this American liquor maker moved to Canada
breaking_news.summary: Phillips Distilling lost 70% of its Canadian business after provinces banned the sale of US liquor. It has since found a way to sell its products in Canada again.

breaking_news.headline: Humanoid robots 'the future' of car making, says BMW
breaking_news.summary: BMW is introducing humanoid robots to a car plant in Europe, building on similar projects in the US.

breaking_news.headline: US government prepares to print $250 note featuring Trump's face
breaking_news.summary: Federal law bars printing images of living people on US currency, but Trump allies in Congress are moving to make an exception.
